name: degree_distribution
author: efd53284
description: Computes the degree distribution of a graph: how many nodes have degree 0, 1, 2, and so on. Use it to answer questions about the spread of connectivity. Works on directed and undirected graphs, weighted or unweighted; on a directed graph degree is out_degree + in_degree, and edge weights are ignored because degree counts edges. Returns a list of degree/count buckets sorted by degree, including degree 0 when isolated nodes exist; result_graph_id is null.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse
